safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Rasimu — inapitiwa. Hatua za kwanza za utulivu kwa saa 24 za kwanza baada ya kurudia zitaonekana hapa baada ya kupitishwa. Huko peke yako.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Huko peke yako. Kitufe cha dharura hapo juu kiko hapa kila wakati — piga simu au tuma ujumbe kwa 988, au 911 ukiwa dharurani.

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Tafuta mahali salama pa kukaa (piga 211 au rasilimali za makazi za mitaa)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Tafuta chakula cha wiki hii (piga 211 au ghala la chakula la mitaa)

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.resourcesNote.draft: Msaada wa kisheria, matibabu na usafiri. Saraka hii haihusishi chakula wala makazi.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Hati zako zimesimbwa. Hiki ni kipengele cha mpango wa kulipia; hakuna bei iliyowekwa bado.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: Mpango wa kulipia. Hakuna bei iliyowekwa bado.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Angalia masharti ya msamaha wako wa masharti na afisa wako kabla ya kuomba.

phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Kazi fupi za mitaa. Angalia masharti ya msamaha na afisa wako. Nambari za simu hazionyeshwi kamwe.

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Weka kila tarehe ya mahakama na kila ripoti kwenye kalenda

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Angalia faini, ada na fidia zako

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Malengo ya akiba na mpango wa maandalizi ya makazi. Groundwork haitoi makazi wala haishirikiani na watoa huduma. Kwa msaada wa mitaa, piga 211.
